name: Elan Empire
summary: Project existence, developer (Elan Group), Sector 66 Golf Course Extension Road location, RERA GGM/736/468/2023/80, under-construction status and 1.46-acre land area are confirmed. Our June 2026 possession conflicts with the April 2028 date given by Square Yards and another portal (one older listing says June 2025), and our Rs 1 Cr starting price sits above the Rs 74-93 lakh entry prices on the portals. Floors (6) are confirmed by only one broker page; units (351) are published elsewhere but not by us.

checks.web: Elan Empire, commercial project (retail, food court, office) in Sector 66, Gurgaon
checks.note: Listed on Square Yards and several broker sites.

checks.ours: Sector 66, Golf Course Extension Road, Sector 66, Gurugram, Haryana
checks.web: Sector 66, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurgaon
GGM/736/468/2023/80 dated 24.07.2023 (Square Yards, megarealtymax); propzilla instead cites GGM/469/201/2021/37
checks.note: Our number is confirmed by two sources. One broker page cites a different 2021 registration (GGM/469/201/2021/37), possibly an earlier phase or registration. This was not checked on the HARERA portal.
No source gives June 2026. The most-cited date (April 2028, likely the RERA date) is almost 2 years later than ours. Sources disagree with each other.
